label: Salesforce
description: Search and query CRM records, and create or update accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, campaigns, tasks, and notes.
securityDescription: Salesforce sign-in opens through Composio, which asks for the org's My Domain. Agents can read the records the connected user can reach and run SOQL queries. With write access, Agents can create and update accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, campaigns, and tasks, and add notes. A new contact or lead can carry an email address. Agents cannot change a record's owner, an existing person's email or phone, or a parent or account link, send email, delete records, run bulk or composite requests, upload files, run Apex tests, or create custom objects, fields, flows, or validation rules.

drop.SALESFORCE_CREATE_CUSTOM_FIELD: Changes org metadata for every user.
drop.SALESFORCE_CREATE_CUSTOM_OBJECT: Changes org metadata for every user.
drop.SALESFORCE_CREATE_TOOLING_FLOW: Creates automation that can act on records and send email without an Agent call.
drop.SALESFORCE_CREATE_VALIDATION_RULE: Changes org metadata and can block other users from saving records.
drop.SALESFORCE_GET_COMPOSITE_RESOURCES: Lists composite API endpoints, which no capability here can call.
drop.SALESFORCE_RUN_TESTS_ASYNCHRONOUS: Runs Apex code in the org.
drop.SALESFORCE_RUN_TESTS_SYNCHRONOUS: Runs Apex code in the org.
drop.SALESFORCE_UPLOAD_FILE: file and filename are withheld, so the tool cannot upload anything.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent account if this is a subsidiary. Must be a valid Salesforce Account Id (15- or 18-character).

billing_state.description: Billing address state/province. For US/Canada addresses, use full state/province names (e.g., 'California', 'New York', 'Ontario') or abbreviations ('CA', 'NY') which are auto-converted. For other countries, leave empty unless you know the exact valid picklist value for your Salesforce org. WARNING: If State/Country Picklists are enabled in your org, only pre-configured values are accepted; arbitrary region names will be rejected with FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION.

shipping_state.description: Shipping address state/province. For US/Canada addresses, use full state/province names (e.g., 'California', 'New York', 'Ontario') or abbreviations ('CA', 'NY') which are auto-converted. For other countries, leave empty unless you know the exact valid picklist value for your Salesforce org. WARNING: If State/Country Picklists are enabled in your org, only pre-configured values are accepted; arbitrary region names will be rejected with FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION.

capabilities.description: Creates a new campaign in Salesforce. Only `name` is universally required, but org-level validation rules commonly enforce `type`, `status`, `start_date`, and `end_date` as well — omitting them may cause creation to fail.

end_date.description: Campaign end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

is_active.description: Whether the campaign is currently active. Depending on org configuration, setting to `true` may require valid `start_date`/`end_date` ranges; violations raise a non-retriable `CANNOT_INSERT_UPDATE_ACTIVATE_ENTITY` error.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent campaign if this is a child campaign.

start_date.description: Campaign start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

actual_cost.description: Actual cost spent on the campaign.

number_sent.description: Number of individuals targeted by the campaign.

expected_response.description: Expected response rate as a percentage.

capabilities.description: Creates a new task in Salesforce to track activities, to-dos, and follow-ups related to contacts, leads, or other records. Ensure who_id, what_id, and owner_id reference existing records before calling; invalid IDs cause silent linkage failures or validation errors.

withheldArguments.owner_id: changes sharing, visibility, permissions, membership, or who acts

status.description: Status of the task. Must be a valid picklist value; arbitrary strings trigger validation errors.

who_id.description: ID of the Contact or Lead this task is associated with. Only accepts Contact IDs (prefix '003') or Lead IDs (prefix '00Q'). Do NOT use Account/Opportunity/Case IDs here; use what_id for those. Swapping who_id and what_id creates orphaned tasks that won't appear on contact/lead timelines. Accepts only a single ID; create separate task records for multiple contacts.

what_id.description: ID of the related record (Account, Opportunity, Case, etc.) this task is associated with. Accepts Account IDs (prefix '001'), Opportunity IDs (prefix '006'), Case IDs (prefix '500'), and other business object IDs.

description.description: Detailed description or notes for the task.

activity_date.description: Due date for the task in YYYY-MM-DD format. Do not use full datetimes or natural-language strings like 'yesterday'; only YYYY-MM-DD is accepted.

is_reminder_set.description: Whether to set a reminder for this task.

reminder_date_time.description: Date and time for the reminder in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Required if is_reminder_set is true. Interpreted according to org/user timezone, not UTC.

composio_execution_message.description: Internal field used to communicate processing details.

capabilities.description: Tool to retrieve multiple Salesforce records in a single request with customizable field selection. Use when you need to fetch data for multiple records at once (up to 200 records).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of qualified field names to retrieve. Format: ObjectApiName.FieldName (e.g., 'Account.Name,Account.Phone'). If the user doesn't have access to a field, an error occurs. Either fields or optionalFields must be provided.

record_ids.description: Comma-separated list of record IDs to retrieve. All record IDs must be from supported objects. Maximum 200 records per request.

optional_fields.description: Comma-separated list of qualified optional field names. Format: ObjectApiName.FieldName (e.g., 'Account.AnnualRevenue'). If the user doesn't have access to an optional field, it's excluded from the response without error. Can be used with fields parameter. Either fields or optionalFields must be provided.

capabilities.description: Retrieves multiple records of the same object type by IDs with a request body. Use when you need to retrieve more records than URL length limits allow (up to 2000 records vs ~800 via GET).

ids.description: Array of record IDs to retrieve. Maximum 2000 IDs per request.

fields.description: Array of field names to retrieve for each record. Specifies which fields to return in the response.

sobject_name.description: The sObject type name (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Lead', 'Opportunity'). This specifies which type of records to retrieve.

capabilities.description: Retrieves a specific contact by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

fields.description: Comma-delimited string of Contact field API names to retrieve. If omitted, all fields are returned.

contact_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the contact to retrieve. Must be a valid 18-character Salesforce ID; names or emails are not valid substitutes.

capabilities.description: Returns the binary content of a Salesforce file, including references to external files. Use when you need to download or retrieve the actual file data from Salesforce.

file_id.description: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the ContentDocument or ContentVersion file to retrieve.

version_id.description: Specifies a particular version of the file to retrieve. If not specified, returns the latest version.

rendition_type.description: Specifies the type of file rendition to return. Available values: THUMB120BY90, THUMB240BY180, THUMB720BY480, SVGZ, ORIGINAL_<File_Extension>.

capabilities.description: Retrieves a specific lead by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

lead_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the lead to retrieve. Must be a Salesforce record ID (18-char format like '00QWd000005V3RmMAK'); names, emails, or external codes are not accepted — resolve to a Salesforce ID first using a search or query tool.

capabilities.description: Tool to retrieve metadata for multiple list views in a single batch request. Use when you need to get list view configuration, columns, filters, and sorting for multiple list views at once.

list_view_ids.description: Comma-separated list of list view IDs to retrieve metadata for. Use the 18-character Salesforce list view IDs.

capabilities.description: Retrieves a specific opportunity by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

fields.description: Comma-delimited string of Opportunity field API names to retrieve. If omitted, all fields are returned. Custom objects may use non-standard API names for common fields (e.g., primary contact); verify exact field API names and handle null values.

opportunity_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the opportunity to retrieve. Must be a valid 15 or 18 character alphanumeric Salesforce ID (e.g., '006Wd000005FG3CIAW'). When multiple similarly named opportunities exist in search results, confirm the correct record by `Id` or other key attributes before passing the ID here.

capabilities.description: Tool to retrieve organization limits with max and remaining allocations. Use when you need to check API usage, storage limits, or other resource consumption in Salesforce.

input.description: Request model for retrieving organization limits. No parameters required.

capabilities.description: Tool to get a batch of related list user preferences from Salesforce. Use when retrieving display preferences, column widths, or sort orders for multiple related lists simultaneously.

related_list_ids.description: Comma-separated list of related list IDs. Each ID follows the format 'objectApiName.relatedListId' (e.g., 'Account.Contacts,Account.Opportunities').

capabilities.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data. Returns records matching the query with pagination support.

query.description: SOQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT. Field names must match object schema exactly — use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT for unfamiliar objects. ALIASES: No 'AS' keyword (use 'SUM(Amount) TotalSales' NOT 'SUM(Amount) AS TotalSales'). AGGREGATES: Without GROUP BY, ORDER BY/LIMIT not allowed (single-row result). COUNT() SYNTAX: Bare COUNT() only valid alone. With GROUP BY or other fields, must specify field: COUNT(Id) or COUNT(fieldName).

capabilities.description: Search for Salesforce accounts using criteria like name, industry, type, location, or contact information. Always provide at least one filter parameter; omitting all filters returns a broad, slow listing. Owner/territory filtering is unsupported — use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY for ownership-based filters. Use SALESFORCE_GET_ACCOUNT to fetch complete field data for a specific record. Unsupported filter fields may be silently ignored — verify results reflect intended criteria.

name.description: Search by account name. Supports partial matches.

type.description: Search by account type. Note: The Type field may not exist in all Salesforce orgs. If the query fails with 'No such column Type', either omit this parameter or use a custom Type__c field if available in your org.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return. Results are hard-capped at approximately 2000 rows; use more selective filters if the full dataset exceeds this.

phone.description: Search by phone number. Supports partial matches. Requires field-level security access to the Phone field.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of valid Salesforce Account field API names to retrieve. Only use actual field names like Id, Name, Industry, etc. Do not include type annotations or placeholders like <string> or <DATE_TIME>. If any field in this list is restricted by field-level security, the entire request will fail — use a minimal set of standard fields (e.g., Id,Name,Website) when access is uncertain.

website.description: Search by website. Supports partial matches.

billing_city.description: Search by billing city. Supports partial matches.

billing_state.description: Search by billing state/province. Supports partial matches.

billing_country.description: Search by billing country. Supports partial matches.

capabilities.description: Search Salesforce Contact records (not Leads — use SALESFORCE_SEARCH_LEADS for those) using name, email, phone, account, or title. All parameters support partial/fuzzy matching, so results may include unrelated records; post-filter client-side for exact matches. Partial matches and common names can return multiple contacts — always confirm the correct contact by its 18-character Id before passing to write operations like SALESFORCE_LOG_CALL or SALESFORCE_CREATE_TASK. A response with totalSize=0 is a valid 'not found' outcome. Provide at least one search criterion; omitting all returns a broad, slow result set. Returned Ids are 18-character strings and must be used as-is in downstream tools.

name.description: Search by contact name (first name, last name, or full name). Supports partial matches.

email.description: Search by email address. Supports partial matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return. Maximum allowed is 2000; when totalSize exceeds limit, paginate to retrieve full results.

phone.description: Search by phone number. Supports partial matches.

title.description: Search by job title. Supports partial matches.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Contact fields to retrieve. Custom and non-default fields are excluded unless explicitly listed here.

account_name.description: Search by associated account name. Supports partial matches.

capabilities.description: Search for Salesforce leads using criteria like name, email, phone, company, title, status, or lead source. At least one search criterion should be provided — omitting all parameters results in a broad, slow listing of arbitrary records. Partial matches on name, email, and company may return multiple candidates; confirm Email or Company field values before using a lead ID in downstream operations.

name.description: Search by lead name (first name, last name, or full name). Supports partial matches.

email.description: Search by email address. Supports partial matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of leads to return. Maximum cap is 2000; for result sets beyond 2000, use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY with pagination via nextRecordsUrl.

phone.description: Search by phone number. Supports partial matches.

title.description: Search by job title. Supports partial matches.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Lead fields to retrieve.

company.description: Search by company name. Supports partial matches.

capabilities.description: Search for Salesforce opportunities using multiple criteria like name, account, stage, amount, close date, or status. Apply at least one filter to avoid broad result sets. Partial-match searches may return multiple similar records; verify the correct record by Id before downstream use.

name.description: Search by opportunity name. Supports partial matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of opportunities to return. Maximum value is 2000. When totalSize in the response exceeds limit, use nextRecordsUrl to paginate through the full dataset.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Opportunity fields to retrieve. Supports direct Opportunity fields (e.g., Id, Name, Amount) and parent relationship fields (e.g., Account.Name, Owner.Name). Note: Contact.* fields (Contact.Name, Contact.Email, etc.) are NOT valid because Opportunity does not have a direct parent relationship to Contact; use OpportunityContactRole queries to get contact information.

is_won.description: Filter by won status. True for won opportunities, False for lost (only applies to closed opportunities).

is_closed.description: Filter by closed status. True for closed opportunities, False for open.

account_name.description: Search by associated account name. Supports partial matches.

close_date_to.description: Search opportunities with close date before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

close_date_from.description: Search opportunities with close date from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). When computing relative ranges (e.g., 'this week'), derive dates using the user's local timezone to avoid off-by-one-day errors.

capabilities.description: Search for Salesforce tasks using multiple criteria like subject, status, priority, assigned user, related records, or dates. Always provide at least one filter criterion — no filters produces broad, slow results. For complex filtering not supported here, use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return. Maximum is 2000. When returned record count equals limit or nextRecordsUrl is present in the response, paginate to retrieve all matching tasks.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Task fields to retrieve. WhoId/Who.Name, WhatId/What.Name, OwnerId/Owner.Name, and Description can be null on Task records — guard against null before accessing nested .Name fields. Call-specific fields (CallType, CallDurationInSeconds) are frequently null and unreliable as sole filters.

subject.description: Search by task subject. Supports partial matches. Many Tasks are system-generated or email-related; combine with activity_date_from/activity_date_to, status, and priority for better precision.

is_closed.description: Filter by closed status. True for completed tasks, False for open tasks.

account_name.description: Search by related account name. Supports partial matches.

contact_name.description: Search by related contact name. Supports partial matches.

activity_date_to.description: Search tasks with activity date before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

assigned_to_name.description: Search by assigned user name. Supports partial matches.

activity_date_from.description: Search tasks with activity date from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Date filtering may not strictly bound results; verify ActivityDate in returned records when date accuracy matters.
